claim_text: We have developed our first Climate Adaptation and Resilience Plan to help us reduce exposure to present-day climate hazards, and strengthen our ability to anticipate, absorb, respond and recover from physical climate change impacts.
metric_name: Climate Adaptation and Resilience Plan; resilience case studies
context_text: We have developed our first Climate Adaptation and Resilience Plan to help us reduce exposure ...；Building on our physical resilience approach, we implemented a number of measures to strengthen our resilience to physical climate risks during the year.；Case study disclosures include Pilbara rail and Dampier seawater desalination plant.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 报告能够证明South32已制定适应与韧性计划，并披露若干适应案例，但没有量化结果来证明这些举措已实际“reduce exposure”或显著提升恢复能力，因此仅部分支撑。
notes: 计划存在，不等于效果已被验证。
